gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada reads open and clean, its bulky lowercase keeping every line dense without ever closing its curves into rings. Goldman is the one for bold, wide statements; this body just carries on.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and modern, Noto Sans Siddham fills its text line with a generous middle band. Under Goldman's wide, commanding capitals, a long passage would read in a plain sans rhythm, with the s ends hanging loose and easy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, its curve endings staying well apart from each other. Goldman's wide shapes sit above it, and a long passage would feel dense but unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo has a sizable x-height made for screens, and its curved letters keep wide, unclosed mouths. And Goldman's roomy, parenthesis-like rounds give the top of the page a bold stance that this plain sans quietly follows.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese keeps its e crossbars open and its capitals close to the lowercase. Goldman does the commanding, widely spaced display work best, while the sans-serif body is built to hold steady line after line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Approachable from the first line, with curves that leave daylight, short ascender stems and tall lowercase bodies. Noto Sans Sunuwar handles the steady reading, whereas Goldman is best when its wide, bold letters get to command attention.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri pairs short ascenders with a tall x-height, and its a opens the lower bowl to breathe. And over a longer stretch, that sans feels clean and professional beneath Goldman's wide, bold headings.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Modern, wide and bold up top. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke, so a long passage in this plain sans feels like tightly bundled cable, dense yet clean.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Goldman sets widely spaced, bold letters with round forms like open parentheses. And Noto Sans Tagalog does its own work best, a middle-heavy sans-serif texture with generous gaps in the curves.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa fills most of the line height with lowercase, and its open curves keep clear gaps beneath Goldman's commanding capitals. A long passage in this plain sans stays clean and modern.
